scripts.text: My heart is beating so fast. Ahhh~
Why is you face so flushed? Ha ha ha.
scripts.translation: 你的脸怎么这么红？哈哈。

scripts.text: Don't make fun of me Mimi~
I have dreamed of being at Dancer Kim's stage for a very long time!
scripts.translation: 我做梦都想看舞娘 金的现场演出，盼了好久呢！

scripts.text: I might lose my senses if I really see her dancing like a beautiful angel sent from above.
scripts.translation: 真看到她像下凡天使般翩翩起舞，我肯定会激动得晕过去。

scripts.text: You are going to faint even before the performance starts. Ha ha.
scripts.translation: 演出还没开始你就要晕倒了。哈哈。

scripts.text: Many people are looking forward to meeting the best Wanderer in the world.
scripts.translation: 很多人都很期待见到世界上最棒的浪姬舞者。

scripts.text: What? You don't know the famous Wanderer, Dancer Kim?
scripts.translation: 什么？你不知道著名的浪姬舞者，舞娘 金？

scripts.text: You seem to know the art of dancing but how come you don't know her?
scripts.translation: 你似乎很懂舞蹈，怎么会不知道她呢？

scripts.text: A Wanderer is a free-spirited person who wanders about the world with the wind and the stars.
scripts.translation: 浪姬舞者是自由奔放的人，随着风与星辰在世界各地漫游。

scripts.text: Rhythm and Music accompany them wherever they go.
scripts.translation: 无论走到哪里，节奏与音乐都会伴随她们。

scripts.text: Dancer Kim is the most famous Wanderer who tours the world with the Maestro Guitar Dong as the team <Nollio>.
scripts.translation: 舞娘 金是最著名的浪姬舞者，她与吉他手 东组成的乐队<诺利奥>正在环游世界。

scripts.text: Soy and myself are Aspiring Wanderers, and there will be a performance of <Nollio> in this town soon, so we are eagerly looking forward to see it.
scripts.translation: 我和索伊都想成为浪姬舞者，<诺利奥>很快就要来这里演出了，我们盼着呢。

scripts.text: If you are a true Dancer, you must be struck with her Dance!
scripts.translation: 真正热爱舞蹈的人，都会被她打动！

scripts.text: Will I ever meet a Maestro like Guitar Song someday, Mimi?
scripts.translation: 米米，我以后也能遇到吉他之歌那样的音乐大师吗？

scripts.text: Just hang in there, Soy. Ha ha.
Right in front of the Christmas tree!
White snow, beautiful melody, and my captivating dance.
scripts.translation: 洁白的雪、优美的旋律，还有我迷人的舞姿。

scripts.text: Don't you think it would be a great performance?
scripts.translation: 你不觉得这场演出一定会很精彩吗？

scripts.text: If you are interested in becoming a Wanderer, just come back to me anytime. Although I'm not perfect, I will try my best to help you.
scripts.translation: 如果你有兴趣成为浪姬舞者，随时可以来找我。虽然我还不够完美，但会尽力帮助你。

scripts.text: The performance will be held in front of the Christmas tree here in Lutie.
scripts.translation: 演出将在姜饼城的圣诞树前举行。

scripts.text: I can't wait! Ah~ I'm losing my senses, Mimi.
scripts.translation: 我等不及了！啊~我要失去理智了，米米。

scripts.text: A Wanderer's dancing charm is higher than that of a dancer or gypsy, everyone will lose their souls when they see their performance.
scripts.translation: 浪姬舞者的舞蹈魅力胜过舞娘和冷艳舞姬，看到她们表演的人都会为之着迷。

scripts.text: I want to become a Wanderer, but I'm still a dancer.
scripts.translation: 我也想成为浪姬舞者，但现在还只是个舞娘。

scripts.text: But I think^3131FF it's better to learn Gypsy's unique skills first, and then become a Wanderer^000000. Soy can't wait to become a Wanderer.
scripts.translation: 我觉得^3131FF最好先学会冷艳舞姬的独有技能，再成为浪姬舞者^000000，可索伊已经等不及了。

scripts.text: I want to become an famous Wanderer too, Mimi.
scripts.translation: 米米，我也想成为著名的浪姬舞者。

scripts.text: Not sure if I'm greedy, but I need to learn all Dancer and Gypsy skills before I can become a Wanderer.
scripts.translation: 不知道我是不是太贪心了，但在成为浪姬舞者之前，我需要学会所有舞娘和冷艳舞姬的技能。
其实我不该告诉任何人。

scripts.text: But I'm so overwhelmed that I might go crazy. Ahhhh~~!
scripts.translation: 可是我快受不了了，简直要疯了。啊啊啊~~！

scripts.text: Why are you telling me this?
That's a bit harsh don't you think?
The performance is supposed to be soon!
Those people don't feel any responsibility..
scripts.translation: 那些人完全没有责任感...

scripts.text: We're all expecting them and I've promoted them a lot.
scripts.translation: 大家都在期待他们，我也大力宣传了。

scripts.text: I told you that I'm overwhelmed!
It has nothing to do with me.
Maybe they will even throw a big snowman, no!
scripts.translation: 说不定还会扔一个大雪人过来，不要啊！

scripts.text: People might grab me by the collar!!
scripts.translation: 人们可能会揪住我的衣领！！

scripts.text: They are the worst people in the world.
scripts.translation: 他们是世界上最糟糕的人。

scripts.text: What a heartless thing to say!
Wouldn't you be afraid of all the eyes of people if you were me?
scripts.translation: 换作是你，面对那么多人的目光难道不害怕吗？

scripts.text: I am in charge of this performance! A lot of people are looking forward to see it and there are many sponsors who are supporting us! I'm so stressed.
scripts.translation: 我是这场演出的负责人！很多人都在期待这场演出，还有那么多赞助商在支持我们！我压力好大。

scripts.text: And they didn't give me any reason whatsoever!
scripts.translation: 而且他们连个理由都没给我！

scripts.text: Besides the money I spent for promoting and setting up the stage..
scripts.translation: 先不说我花在宣传和搭建舞台上的钱...

scripts.text: How can I handle all the angry people?
scripts.translation: 我该怎么应付那么多生气的人？

scripts.text: I see that you are worried that the performance is going down the drain.
You wanted to make a successful performance to meet the fan's expectations.
scripts.translation: 你也想办场好演出，不辜负粉丝的期待。

scripts.text: I really don't know how I should manage this.
scripts.translation: 我真的不知道该怎么处理这件事。

scripts.text: Why did they suddenly cancel the performance?
scripts.translation: 他们为什么突然取消演出？

scripts.text: Why is <Nollio> taking this kind of attitude towards me?
Did I make any mistakes? After making a contract with them, I did everything they demanded of me!
scripts.translation: 我哪里做错了？签约以后，他们的要求我全都照办！

scripts.text: What the hell are you talking about?
Are you teasing me because I'm emotionally unstable?
scripts.translation: 看我心神不宁，拿我取乐是吧？

scripts.text: Oh, I'm so worried that I'm having heart palpitations and I'm starting to feel dizzy!
scripts.translation: 哦，我担心得心跳加速，开始头晕了！

scripts.text: Hey! Can you please go out and find the Maestro Guitar Song?
scripts.translation: 嘿！你能不能出去找找吉他之歌大师？

scripts.text: It's because you seem like a similar artist.
scripts.translation: 是因为你看起来也是同行。

scripts.text: You also wanted to watch the performance, didn't you?
I would grab them by their collars if I could!
scripts.translation: 要是能抓住他们的衣领就好了！

scripts.text: I would tell them Why are you spoiling the performance? but for now, dealing with the angry sponsors is hard enough... Oh, no!
scripts.translation: 我要问问他们为什么要破坏演出？不过现在，光是应付那些愤怒的赞助商就已经够难了...啊，不！

scripts.text: I don't know where Guitar Song is, but it is clear that he likes to visit the Comodo Casino!
scripts.translation: 不知道吉他之歌现在在哪儿，不过他最爱去克魔岛赌场！

scripts.text: Hu, Hurry up!! Oh, I really feel dizzy! Guitar Song!!!
scripts.translation: 快、快去！我都快急晕了！吉他之歌啊！！！

scripts.text: I am not sure if Guitar Song is in Comodo, you should go there and find him!
scripts.translation: 我不确定吉他之歌在不在克魔岛，你去那里找找他吧！

scripts.text: Thanks to you, the performance was successful.
In return, I will prepare the stage for you someday.
scripts.translation: 作为回报，改天我会为你准备舞台。
- 你发现了一位乐团大师 -

scripts.text: - What a weird person, I better stay away. -
scripts.translation: - 真是个怪人，我还是离他远点好。-
什么？！居然无视我这首不朽巨作《铃鼓之王》？

scripts.text: Are you ignoring my immortal masterpiece <Tambourine King>? You are the first person who's ever slapped me in the face.
scripts.translation: 你要无视我的不朽杰作<铃鼓之王>吗？你还是第一个敢打我脸的人。

scripts.text: Oh! Lady, looking at your appearance you must be a dancer, right?
scripts.translation: 哦！女士，看你的外表，你一定是个舞娘，对吧？

scripts.text: Do you have a Bard or Minstrel traveling together with you?
scripts.translation: 你有诗人或宫廷乐师和你一起旅行吗？

scripts.text: If you don't, how about making a traveling troupe with me?
scripts.translation: 如果没有，要不要和我一起组建一个旅行剧团？

scripts.text: The name of the team is <Guitar Song's Agony>.
scripts.translation: 这个组合名叫<吉他之歌的苦恼>。

scripts.text: This name expresses the excruciating pain it takes to create art works.
scripts.translation: 这个名字表达了创作艺术作品时所承受的煎熬。

scripts.text: It has an edgy kind of name So I think that it will be a very popular group.
scripts.translation: 这个名字很有个性，我觉得它会非常受欢迎。

scripts.text: Huh... I'm a bit disappointed that you finally recognize me now.
scripts.translation: 哼...你现在才认出我，真让我有点失望。

scripts.text: Yes, I am the handsome Guitar Song in the famous group <Nollio>.
scripts.translation: 没错，我就是著名组合<诺利奥>里的帅气成员吉他之歌。

scripts.text: So how about it? Isn't that a tempting offer to you?
I'm a really famous Maestro at the peak of my popularity. People are dying to work with me, but you are indifferent to me lady.
scripts.translation: 我可是红极一时的大乐师，想和我合作的人多了去了，小姐，你倒不为所动。

scripts.text: Why are you asking me that question so suddenly?
Come on, let's just talk about a pleasant matter.
scripts.translation: 好了，我们聊点开心的事吧。

scripts.text: Dancer Kim and the performance have nothing to do with me.
scripts.translation: 舞娘 金和演出跟我没有任何关系。

scripts.text: Hey, I told you to stop talking about this matter....
scripts.translation: 嘿，我说过别提这件事了...

scripts.text: I don't want to think about it. It just hurts my feelings.
scripts.translation: 我不想再想起这件事，心里很不好受。

scripts.text: - Guitar Song is adamantly refusing to talk. What should I do to hear the story about <Nollio>? -
scripts.translation: - 吉他之歌就是不肯开口，要怎么才能问出<诺利奥>的事呢？-

scripts.text: (Would it be possible for me to make him tell me what happened with Nollio?)
scripts.translation: （有没有办法让他说说，诺利奥究竟出了什么事？）

scripts.text: - You get closer to Song's ear. -
scripts.translation: - 你凑近吉他之歌的耳边。-
你差点把我的耳膜震破了。

scripts.text: You should know, people are addicted to your music?
scripts.translation: 你知道吗，大家都沉迷于你的音乐？

scripts.text: So many people are supporting you with anticipation.
scripts.translation: 有这么多人满怀期待地支持你。

scripts.text: Would you break your promise and let people down? Not giving people any reason?
scripts.translation: 你要违背承诺，让大家失望吗？不给大家一个交代吗？

scripts.text: What... what are you doing?!! What's wrong with you!
scripts.translation: 你...你在干什么？！你疯了吗！

scripts.text: - You cannot use this skill without learning it. -
scripts.translation: - 还没学会这个技能，无法使用。-

scripts.text: Looks like I will not get answer even if I force him.
scripts.translation: 看来即使强迫他，我也得不到答案。

scripts.text: - You cannot use this skill without learning it. -
scripts.translation: - 还没学会这个技能，无法使用。-
我关注<诺利奥>已经好几年了。

scripts.text: I know that we are that popular! Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation: 我知道我们很受欢迎！哈哈哈！

scripts.text: I've seen other Maestro's performances but there was no one better than Guitar Song.
scripts.translation: 我看过其他乐师的表演，但没有谁比得上吉他之歌。

scripts.text: He he he! Yes, I know I am super great!
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿嘿！是的，我知道我超级棒！

scripts.text: Oh... When I hear Guitar Song's performance for the first time I has a crush on you immediately.
scripts.translation: 啊...第一次听你的演奏，我就被你迷住了。

scripts.text: It felt like hearing mommy's lullaby~ It was so beautiful and moving... You are the best artist of our time.
scripts.translation: 那感觉就像听到妈妈的摇篮曲~ 太美太动人了...你是我们这个时代最伟大的艺术家。

scripts.text: Ha ha ha. I know that well, but it feels good to hear a compliment from you!
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈。我知道，但听到你的赞美感觉真好！

scripts.text: So I was looking forward to seeing your performance in Lutie this time.
scripts.translation: 所以我一直期待这次在姜饼城看到你的表演。

scripts.text: But after I heard the performance got cancelled, I felt so sad.
scripts.translation: 但听说表演取消了，我感到非常难过。

scripts.text: Now I can't hear Guitar Song's melody~~
scripts.translation: 再也听不到你的旋律了吗~~

scripts.text: I wanted to dance to your music like a beautiful butterfly.
scripts.translation: 我还想像蝴蝶一样，伴着你的音乐起舞。

scripts.text: Is there no way for my dream to be true now? Sob sob...
scripts.translation: 难道这个梦，再也实现不了了？呜呜...

scripts.text: Huh huh! No, that is not...
I am really happy to meet you in person, but I hope to see your performance in the beautiful snowy town, Lutie.. Sob sob...
scripts.translation: 我很高兴能亲自见到你，但我希望能在美丽的雪城姜饼城看到你的表演。呜呜呜...

scripts.text: Why in the world don't you show us the performance, Guitar Song?
scripts.translation: 吉他之歌，你为什么不给我们表演呢？

scripts.text: Don't you like me? Sob sob..
No, it's not that kind of reason!
Then please tell me, I really love your music... but now I feel so blue...
scripts.translation: 那就告诉我嘛，我这么喜欢你的音乐...现在心里好难过...

scripts.text: I want to have a performance, too!
But I cannot do it all by myself!
It's all because of Dancer Kim!
scripts.translation: 这都是舞娘 金的错！

scripts.text: One day, she suddenly got mad and told me that she would quit <Nollio>!
scripts.translation: 有一天，她突然发火，说要退出<诺利奥>！

scripts.text: I was also tired of here unpredictable feelings, too!
scripts.translation: 我也受够了她变幻莫测的情绪！

scripts.text: Why did she get mad so suddenly?
I don't know! She must be holding a grudge for something.
scripts.translation: 我不知道！她一定是因为什么事在记恨我。

scripts.text: She suddenly disappeared and sent me a letter telling me that the team would be disbanded.
scripts.translation: 她突然消失了，还给我寄了一封信，说乐队要解散了。
舞娘 金现在在哪里？

scripts.text: Well, the letter was sent from Hugel.
scripts.translation: 嗯，那封信是从毁葛寄来的。

scripts.text: I guess she might be back at her hometown.
scripts.translation: 我想她可能回到了家乡。

scripts.text: That's where I met her for the first time.
scripts.translation: 那是我第一次遇见她的地方。

scripts.text: Although she loses her temper easily, her dance is so wonderful....
scripts.translation: 虽然她很容易发脾气，但她的舞蹈真的很美妙...

scripts.text: I don't know what I am doing wrong.
scripts.translation: 我不知道自己做错了什么。

scripts.text: She smiled so happily that she likes the new song so much..
scripts.translation: 她笑得那么开心，看来很喜欢这首新歌...

scripts.text: Who can dance to my music so wonderfully as she did?
scripts.translation: 谁能像她那样，在我的音乐中跳出如此美妙的舞姿呢？

scripts.text: Now my music and my life is history... (muttering).
scripts.translation: 现在我的音乐和我的人生都成了过去...（喃喃自语）。

scripts.text: Dancer Kim is probably addicted to the monster races in Hugel again!
scripts.translation: 舞娘 金肯定又沉迷于毁葛的魔物赛跑了吧！

scripts.text: Back in the day when she was addicted to the monster races, who do you think got her out of it?
scripts.translation: 当年她沉迷魔物赛跑的时候，是谁把她拉出来的，你知道吗？

scripts.text: - You tell him what happened in Hugel and ask him to go back to Lutie. -
scripts.translation: - 你把毁葛发生的事告诉他，请他回姜饼城去。-
你这个傻乎乎的舞娘金~

scripts.text: Without me, who else can take care of such a lady like you~
scripts.translation: 没有我，还有谁能照顾你这样一位女士呢~

scripts.text: I'll go there right away and scold her.
scripts.translation: 我这就过去好好教训她一顿。

scripts.text: Okay, I will go to the Christmas tree in Lutie where the performance is supposed to be held.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会去姜饼城的圣诞树那里，那里应该是举办表演的地方。

scripts.text: I said goodbye to my partner who had been working with me for a long time.
scripts.translation: 我和那个与我合作了很久的搭档说了再见。

scripts.text: When Wanderers and Maestro's get together, their abilities become stronger.
scripts.translation: 浪姬舞者和乐师搭档，才能发挥更强的力量。

scripts.text: So when they travel, they often get together and perform duets.
scripts.translation: 所以她们旅行时常常会聚在一起合唱二重唱。

scripts.text: They have a good time dancing and playing music.
scripts.translation: 她们尽情跳舞、演奏音乐，过得很开心。

scripts.text: A few days ago, with my partner Guitar Song. I showed a beautiful dance to his music to many people as we usually do.
scripts.translation: 几天前，我和我的搭档吉他之歌，像往常一样，伴着他的音乐向许多人展示了一段优美的舞蹈。

scripts.text: I was really proud of being a Wanderer after I drew all of that enthusiastic applause.
scripts.translation: 在那片热烈的掌声中，我为自己是一名浪姬舞者而感到无比自豪。

scripts.text: I was so happy that day.
The following morning, I woke up and washed my fave and was looking for something to eat in my room..
scripts.translation: 第二天早上，我醒来洗了脸，正在房间里找吃的...

scripts.text: Then Guitar Song suddenly opened the door of my room for some reason and said ^3131FFHey! What the hell are.. you doing here?^000000 and then he threw me out of my room!
scripts.translation: 谁知道，吉他之歌突然推门进来，大喊^3131FF喂！你...你是什么人，怎么在这儿？^000000，然后就把我赶了出去！

scripts.text: We've been together for a long time but how can he do such a thing to me?
scripts.translation: 我们在一起这么久了，他怎么能这样对我？

scripts.text: At first, I thought he was kidding around with me! But when he kicked me out of my room...
scripts.translation: 起初，我以为他只是在跟我开玩笑！但当他把我踢出房间时...

scripts.text: Why didn't he recognize my face?
scripts.translation: 他为什么认不出我的脸？

scripts.text: Do you think he doesn't want to see my face without makeup?
scripts.translation: 你觉得他是不想看到我没化妆的脸吗？

scripts.text: Are you also ignoring my wounded self-respect as a woman?
scripts.translation: 连你也不在乎我身为女人，被伤得这么深的自尊吗？

scripts.text: No! He is really a caring man!
scripts.translation: 不！他真的是个体贴的男人！

scripts.text: But I don't think you disbanded your precious team just because of that.
scripts.translation: 但我觉得你们解散珍贵的队伍，肯定不仅仅是因为这个原因。

scripts.text: It's not just because of that.
The real reason why I disbanded the team is...
scripts.translation: 我解散队伍的真正原因是...

scripts.text: After that day, I went to my hometown, Hugel and I just stayed indoors.
scripts.translation: 那天之后，我回到了家乡毁葛，一直待在家里。

scripts.text: It was then when Shide comforted me with sweet cakes.
scripts.translation: 那时是希德用美味的蛋糕安慰了我。

scripts.text: It is the most famous cake in Hugel with soft sponge cake and fresh fruits and sweet chocolate cream!
scripts.translation: 那是毁葛最有名的蛋糕，有着松软的海绵蛋糕、新鲜的水果和香甜的巧克力奶油！

scripts.text: It felt like all the angels of happiness came to comfort me when I tasted that sweet cake.
scripts.translation: 当我品尝那块甜美的蛋糕时，感觉所有幸福的天使都来安慰我了。

scripts.text: So I ate it every morning and every night.
scripts.translation: 所以我每天早上和晚上都吃它。

scripts.text: The angel of happiness took back my sadness and gave me a lot of belly fat!
scripts.translation: 幸福天使带走了悲伤，却送了我一肚子赘肉！

scripts.text: Now I can't wear my dancing clothes!
scripts.translation: 现在我连舞蹈服都穿不下了！

scripts.text: I am not a dancer who dances like a beautiful butterfly anymore!
scripts.translation: 我不再是那个像美丽蝴蝶一样起舞的舞娘了！

scripts.text: What is worse, it became hard to bend my waist forward!
scripts.translation: 更糟的是，我连腰都弯不下去了！

scripts.text: The performance day is approaching, but the angel of happiness brought me a big obstacle.
scripts.translation: 演出日就要到了，但幸福的天使却给我带来了巨大的障碍。

scripts.text: Now I've fallen into despair again!
I can't let Guitar Song and my fans see me like this!
scripts.translation: 我不能让吉他之歌和我的粉丝看到我这副样子！

scripts.text: Not long ago, I was like a beautiful dove, but now I am just a fat chicken.
scripts.translation: 不久以前，我还像一只美丽的白鸽，如今却成了肥胖的母鸡。

scripts.text: I think the life of Wanderer Dancer Kim is over now.
scripts.translation: 我想浪姬舞者金的生涯到此为止了。

scripts.text: My life cannot get out of abyss now......
scripts.translation: 我的人生掉进深渊，再也爬不出来了...

scripts.text: But I already told Guitar Song that it's all over.
scripts.translation: 但我已经告诉吉他之歌一切都结束了。

scripts.text: Even if it's not over, I cannot do anything right now.
scripts.translation: 即使还没结束，我现在也什么都做不了了。

scripts.text: If you give up, it will be over.
scripts.translation: 如果你放弃，那就真的结束了

scripts.text: Do I really have a way to change it?
scripts.translation: 我真的有办法改变现状吗？

scripts.text: If you work hard, your bossy will be lighter than before!
scripts.translation: 认真锻炼，身体一定能比以前更轻盈！

scripts.text: But I get tired and give up easily.
scripts.translation: 但我很容易累，也很容易放弃。

scripts.text: I think I am going to give up.
Will you exercise together with me?
scripts.translation: 你愿意和我一起锻炼吗？

scripts.text: I'm sure that I would try harder if I had someone to workout with.
scripts.translation: 如果有人在旁边一起锻炼，我相信我会更努力的。

scripts.text: I think I'm gaining strength again!
scripts.translation: 我觉得我又重新获得了力量！

scripts.text: Just go one field South and one field West from here in Hugel.
scripts.translation: 从这里往南经过一张地图，再往西一张地图，就到胡格尔了。

scripts.text: I'll meet you at Abyss Lake.
Please tell Guitar Song to go to Lutie
scripts.translation: 请告诉吉他之歌去姜饼城。

scripts.text: I'll go there after I've packed my luggage!
scripts.translation: 等我收拾好行李就过去！

scripts.text: Exercising together is good but if we compete for it, I think we'll get a better effect!
scripts.translation: 一起锻炼固然好，但如果我们比赛的话，我觉得效果会更好！

scripts.text: From now on, let's compete to see who defeats the Yellow Novus first!
scripts.translation: 从现在开始，我们来比赛谁先击败黄诺博斯吧！

scripts.text: You need to defeat 50 Yellow Novus!
scripts.translation: 你需要击败50只黄诺博斯！

scripts.text: Hurry up before I lose interest!
scripts.translation: 快点啦，别让我失去兴趣！

scripts.text: This feeling reminds me of the past where I've crossed the borders of many continents.
scripts.translation: 这种感觉，让我想起了从前游历各个大陆的日子。

scripts.text: I'm getting slimmer, can you see it?
scripts.translation: 我变苗条了，你看到了吗？

scripts.text: I feel that my body is full of power.
scripts.translation: 我感觉身体充满了力量。

scripts.text: I suddenly want to see my good partner Guitar Song.
scripts.translation: 我突然很想见见我的好搭档吉他之歌。

scripts.text: I want to start dancing again.
My dream to dance in Lutie will finally come true.
scripts.translation: 我在姜饼城跳舞的梦想终于要实现了。

scripts.text: I want to dance and jump all day to bring people happiness!
scripts.translation: 我要尽情起舞，把快乐带给大家！

scripts.text: So I will go to Lutie.
Ah, do me a favor, please.
Can you bring Guitar Song to Lutie?
scripts.translation: 你能带吉他之歌去姜饼城吗？

scripts.text: Say that his partner is waiting for him.
scripts.translation: 告诉他他的搭档在等他。

scripts.text: You're a good person. I'm really happy that I met you.
scripts.translation: 你真是个好心人。我很高兴能遇到你。

scripts.text: Thank god for sending such a stubborn person to me!
scripts.translation: 感谢上天派了这样一个固执的人给我！

scripts.text: Does it look easy to you?
But I'm sure I have a better chance to win.
Oh, you came back to me.
I'm so tired. I don't give up halfway. It's a good exercise for me. I will have to give up Nollio to another Wanderer, it's all over....
scripts.translation: 我好累。我不会半途而废，这对我来说是很好的锻炼。不过，我不得不把诺利奥交给另一位浪姬舞者了，一切都结束了...

scripts.text: - Dancer Kim dropped down by grief and fatigue -
scripts.translation: - 舞娘 金因悲伤和疲惫倒下了 -

scripts.text: Please tell Song, I will be waiting for him at the Christmas tree.
scripts.translation: 请告诉吉他之歌，我会在圣诞树旁等他。

scripts.text: Hunting Novus is the best exercise, I think.
scripts.translation: 我觉得打黄诺博斯是最好的锻炼。

scripts.text: - You can't continue the quest because the condition for the quest is not appropriate. -
scripts.translation: - 由于任务条件不符合，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text: - You can't continue the quest because you have remaining skill points. -
scripts.translation: - 由于你还有剩余的技能点，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text: - You need to empty your inventory if you want to continue the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 如果你想继续任务，需要清空你的物品栏。-

scripts.text: Please get off of that creature you're riding on.
scripts.translation: 请从你骑乘的生物上下来。

scripts.text: Fan! Fan! Fan! I am your fan~
With a strong mind and strong will, I complete fishing~
scripts.translation: 凭着坚强的心与意志，钓鱼大功告成~

scripts.text: So cool! Nollio is the best!!!
scripts.translation: 太酷了！诺利奥是最棒的！！！

scripts.text: We are the romantic Wanderer team <Nollio> who stroll along the world following love and wind!
scripts.translation: 我们是追随爱与风、漫游世界的浪漫表演组合<诺利奥>！

scripts.text: It's so fascinating that I can dance in a snowy, beautiful village,
scripts.translation: 能在这么美丽的雪国村庄起舞，真让人心动。

scripts.text: I'm so glad that I came here, Lutie.
In fact, this wonderfull performance would have been cancelled because of my carelessness.
scripts.translation: 事实上，这场精彩的表演本来会因为我的疏忽而取消。

scripts.text: Let me take this opportunity to say to her that I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 请让我借此机会向她道歉。

scripts.text: I'm sorry for behaving as I did.
In fact there is a friend who cheered me up and helped me get through the hardships I faced when I was depressed in my hometown.
scripts.translation: 我回乡消沉的时候，有位朋友一直鼓励我，陪我渡过了难关。

scripts.text: You may love my friend's dance more than mine in the future.
scripts.translation: 未来你可能会更喜欢我朋友的舞蹈。
这位冉冉升起的浪姬舞者新星，{0}！

scripts.text: Ha ha ha, are you surprised?
You led me here, you deserve it.
scripts.translation: 是你把我带到这里来的，这是你应得的。

scripts.text: Oh! You are like a beautiful swan!
scripts.translation: 哦！你就像一只美丽的天鹅！

scripts.text: The goddess must be jealous to see your beauty.
scripts.translation: 女神看到你的美貌一定会嫉妒的。

scripts.text: {0}! I hope to see your beautiful exploits in the future.
Also, I hope you to meet your precious Maestro.
scripts.translation: 也希望你能见到你珍贵的乐团大师。

scripts.text: Let's perform together later, shall we? Ha ha.
scripts.translation: 以后一起演出吧，好吗？哈哈。

scripts.text: Thanks to you, I didn't lose my precious partner.
scripts.translation: 多亏了你，我没有失去我珍贵的搭档。

scripts.text: Soon I will make a song for you, so wait for it.
scripts.translation: 很快我会为你写一首歌，敬请期待。
